_note: Centralized follow-up scheduler policy (spec §§14, 24, 25). ONE source of truth for follow-up timing offsets, the daily messaging window (10 PM local cutoff), and the single-most-relevant priority order. No follow-up timing is hardcoded across components. Offsets are minutes from the anchor event (last relevant customer message for payment/quote; the Order-Now click for website abandonment). A follow-up that falls due after the cutoff or before the window start is moved to the next window start (never sent outside 08:00-22:00 local).
